# RKG scope: Quisling becomes our leader (the Act of State, or the coup).
wif_rkg_quisling_leads = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_character = NOR_vidkun_quisling } }
		if = {
			limit = { any_country = { has_character = NOR_vidkun_quisling } }
			random_country = {
				limit = { has_character = NOR_vidkun_quisling }
				set_nationality = { target_country = RKG character = NOR_vidkun_quisling }
			}
		}
		else = { recruit_character = NOR_vidkun_quisling }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character = NOR_vidkun_quisling }
		set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = no }
		promote_character = NOR_vidkun_quisling
	}
}

# RKG scope: Quisling turns the Norwegian fascists against the Reichskommissar.
wif_rkg_quisling_coup = {
	set_country_flag = wif_rkg_quisling_state
	# Terboven flees to Germany - to whichever German government will have him.
	if = {
		limit = { has_character = NOR_josef_terboven }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = GER }
			set_nationality = { target_country = GER character = NOR_josef_terboven }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = GAG }
			set_nationality = { target_country = GAG character = NOR_josef_terboven }
		}
		else = { retire_character = NOR_josef_terboven }
	}
	wif_rkg_quisling_leads = yes
	# Out of the Reich - and out of Dover's hands. Not a 'former Reich subject': the
	# reunited Reich does not take Quisling's Norway back by itself.
	if = {
		limit = { is_subject = yes }
		OVERLORD = { end_puppet = PREV }
	}
	if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
	clr_country_flag = wif_cw_former_reich_subject
	clr_country_flag = wif_cw_repuppet_after_war
	if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_german_controlled_reichskommissariat } remove_ideas = GER_german_controlled_reichskommissariat }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_local_controlled_reichskommissariat } remove_ideas = GER_local_controlled_reichskommissariat }
	add_ideas = war_economy
	# Cores on all of Norway, Nordland included.
	if = { limit = { 110 = { is_owned_by = ROOT } } 110 = { add_core_of = ROOT } } if = { limit = { 142 = { is_owned_by = ROOT } } 142 = { add_core_of = ROOT } } if = { limit = { 143 = { is_owned_by = ROOT } } 143 = { add_core_of = ROOT } } if = { limit = { 144 = { is_owned_by = ROOT } } 144 = { add_core_of = ROOT } } if = { limit = { 920 = { is_owned_by = ROOT } } 920 = { add_core_of = ROOT } } if = { limit = { 921 = { is_owned_by = ROOT } } 921 = { add_core_of = ROOT } } if = { limit = { 922 = { is_owned_by = ROOT } } 922 = { add_core_of = ROOT } } if = { limit = { 923 = { is_owned_by = ROOT } } 923 = { add_core_of = ROOT } } if = { limit = { 924 = { is_owned_by = ROOT } } 924 = { add_core_of = ROOT } } if = { limit = { 925 = { is_owned_by = ROOT } } 925 = { add_core_of = ROOT } }

wif_rkg_res_monthly = {
	set_variable = { wif_rkg_res_rate = 1 }
	add_to_variable = { wif_rkg_res_rate = wif_rkg_res_grief }
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_rkg_res_rate min = 0 max = 10 }
	add_to_variable = { wif_rkg_res = wif_rkg_res_rate }
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_rkg_res min = 10 max = 100 }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rkg_chance = wif_rkg_res }
	multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rkg_chance = 0.5 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rkg_trandum } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rkg_chance = 0.8 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rkg_stapo } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rkg_chance = 0.75 } }

	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rkg_xu } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rkg_chance = 0.9 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rkg_reprisals } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rkg_chance = 0.75 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rkg_fragile } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rkg_chance = 0.75 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rkg_res > 89.9 } } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rkg_chance = 1.5 } }
	set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = wif_rkg_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_rkg_roll < wif_rkg_chance } }
		wif_rkg_res_attack = yes
	}
}

wif_rkg_res_attack = {
